title: MIME types for csh or sh shell programs must be disabled.
check_content:
Enter the following commands: 

grep "Action" /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf grep "AddHandler" /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf 

If either of these exist and they configure /bin/csh, or any other shell as a viewer for documents, this is a finding.
fixtext: Disable MIME types for csh or sh shell programs.
VulnDiscussion: Users must not be allowed to access the shell programs. Shell programs might execute shell escapes and could then perform unauthorized activities that could damage the security posture of the web server. A shell is a program that serves as the basic interface between the user and the operating system. In this regard, there are shells that are security risks in the context of a web server and shells that are unauthorized in the context of the Security Features User's Guide.
